title: GenerationTrace
description: The per-block record of what produced a generated document and why. Produced by the core, read by the lawyer review screen and by the client-facing anatomy view.

trace_version.description: The shape of this document. Incremented when a field is added or removed, so a trace archived years ago can still be read.

service_id.description: The service this document was generated for.

blocks.description: One entry per block that entered the document, in document order.

BlockTrust.description: Who wrote the text of a block. `template` is deterministic fill-in of lawyer-authored text, `ai_generated` was produced by the model, `lawyer_edited` was produced by the model and then corrected by a human.

TraceBlock.description: One block of the generated document, and the account of what produced it.

id.description: Stable across regenerations, so a re-run updates the trace rather than scrambling it.

title.description: The block's heading, as the template names it.

needs_attention.description: The core is not confident in this block and a human should read it.

questionnaire_fields.description: Field keys of the client answers that fed this block. Keys only, never values.
